name: Dynamic-KV ShortConv · MLP output
tagline: Head-shared, input-conditioned K/V taps with static attention and MLP output convolutions.
description: Full-attention Dense with independent bias-free K/V generators from the normalized attention input. Dynamic taps share within each head; static taps remain per channel. Attention and MLP output convolutions retain Static ShortConv placement and arithmetic. All taps and generators start at zero.
mechanism: K before RoPE/QK norm; V before value embeddings; static convolutions after attention output and MLP down projections
Kernel four; zero initialization without extra RNG draws; static taps use AdamW, generator matrices use shared Muon
limitations: Adaptation of the cached Inkling 2 dynamic mechanism to the Static ShortConv comparison, not a complete released-model reproduction. No reference convolution scaling or BOS masking. Packed rows reset state. Separate FP32 dynamic accumulation retains the static arithmetic path. Full-sequence training/evaluation only; no incremental KV-cache. Single formal run at seed 42.
